title: Holistic Survey of Privacy and Fairness in Machine Learning

bias_targets.methodology: As a comprehensive survey, the paper does not conduct novel empirical measurements on a specific model or dataset. Instead, it systematically reviews, categorizes, and evaluates existing literature on fairness definitions (e.g., Statistical Parity, Equalized Odds, Equal Opportunity, Counterfactual Fairness) and bias mitigation strategies (pre-processing, in-processing, and post-processing) across supervised, unsupervised, semi-supervised, and reinforcement learning paradigms, referencing various protected attributes like race, gender, age, religion, and disability.
